question:
Select the most appropriate spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The prison is euphemistically called a ‘__rehabillitation__ centre’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rehabillitation"** is incorrectly spelled. It should be **"rehabilitation"**. (पुनर्वास)

 
 
• **Example: **The goal of the program is the rehabilitation of the injured athlete.
 
 
 
• **"Rehabilitation" **refers to the process of restoring someone to health or normal life through training and therapy after imprisonment, addiction, or illness. (पुनर्वास)
 
 
• **Example: **The rehabilitation center helps people recover from substance abuse.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is **'rehabilitation'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.
